task.prompt:
Write/recreate a PostgreSQL PL/pgSQL stored procedure, replacing any existing one with the same signature, with no return value:

`sp(arg1 real, arg2 text, arg3 real, arg4 text)`

arg1 is the RAM amount in MiB, arg2 is the Wi-Fi value, arg3 is used kilobytes, and arg4 is the pixel setting. Only use the chip models, screen modes, and handsets data named here. Track an integer `result_val`, initially 0, and text `status_text`, initially 'pending'.

Start with the first matching arg1 threshold: below 0 sets `result_val` from arg1 times -1 and updates RAM amount for chip models with Wi-Fi value arg2; below 10 sets it from arg1 plus 5 and deletes chip models with RAM amount arg1; below 20 sets it from arg1 times 2 and updates used kilobytes to arg3 plus `result_val` for screen modes with pixel setting arg4; below 30 sets it from arg1 minus 8 and deletes screen modes with used kilobytes arg3; otherwise set it from arg1 divided by 2 and set `status_text` to 'processed'.

Then continue in this exact order against the current data. For matching handsets, append '_screen_match' to accreditation level when screen-mode reference matches the text graphics mode of a screen mode with pixel setting arg4 and used kilobytes arg3; append '_wifi_match' to accreditation type when chip-model reference matches a chip model model name with Wi-Fi value arg2; append '_ram_wifi_match' to hardware model name when chip-model reference matches a chip model model name with RAM amount arg1 and Wi-Fi value arg2; and append '_dual_match' to accreditation type when both the Wi-Fi chip match and the pixel-setting screen match exist, after any '_wifi_match'. Add each suffix at most once per handset.

After those handset updates, set Wi-Fi value to arg2 followed by the current `status_text` for chip models with RAM amount arg1, add 3 to `result_val`, set pixel setting to arg4 followed by '_updated' for screen modes with used kilobytes arg3, delete chip models with RAM amount greater than `result_val`, set `status_text` to 'active', set used kilobytes to arg3 plus 12 for screen modes with pixel setting arg4, set RAM amount to `result_val` for chip models with Wi-Fi value arg2, subtract 7 from `result_val`, delete screen modes with pixel setting arg4 followed by '_old', set Wi-Fi value to arg2 followed by '_final' for chip models with RAM amount arg1, set `status_text` to 'completed', set used kilobytes to arg3 times 3 for screen modes with pixel setting arg4, and finally delete chip models with Wi-Fi value arg2 followed by the completed `status_text`.

Do not add custom exception handling or transaction control. Return the complete stored procedure and nothing else.
